steps.tx: **Chronic kidney disease** (CKD, kidney damage over 3 months) is defined by **estimated glomerular filtration rate** (eGFR, calculated kidney filter rate) below **60 ml per min per 1.73 m2** or albuminuria. **Albumin to creatinine ratio** (urine albumin per gram creatinine) grades damage: A1 normal, A2 moderately raised, A3 severely raised. **Chronic kidney disease progression** (gradual filter loss) affects 800 million people globally. Diabetes and hypertension cause most cases in India.
steps.say: Chronic kidney disease is kidney damage persisting beyond three months, defined by filter rate below sixty or albumin in urine. The albumin to creatinine ratio grades damage from normal to moderately raised to severely raised. About eight hundred million people worldwide live with this disease. Diabetes and hypertension cause most cases in India.

steps.tx: **Diabetic kidney disease** (diabetes driven scarring) leads, followed by hypertensive nephrosclerosis, chronic glomerulonephritis and unknown causes. **Chronic interstitial nephritis** (long term allergic or analgesic injury) follows chronic analgesic use. **Polycystic kidney disease** (cystic hereditary disease) is common in adults with family history. **CKD of unknown aetiology** (CKDu, heat and agricultural exposure in Andhra) is an Indian examination favourite. Obstructive uropathy completes the list.
steps.say: Diabetes driven scarring leads, followed by hypertensive damage and chronic glomerulonephritis. Long term analgesic injury causes interstitial disease. Cystic hereditary disease is common with family history. Heat and agricultural exposure kidney disease in Andhra is an Indian favourite. Blockage completes the list.

steps.tx: Diabetic nephropathy begins with **hyperfiltration** (increased single nephron flow), then **albuminuria** (protein leak), then progressive scarring and **glomerular filtration rate decline**. Hypertensive injury causes arteriolar narrowing and ischaemia. Chronic glomerular inflammation produces **crescents** (cellular scars) that heal into sclerosis. Tubulointerstitial disease scars the interstitium and peritubular capillaries. Proteinuria itself is tubulotoxic and accelerates decline.
steps.say: Diabetic disease begins with hyperfiltration, then albumin leak, then scarring and filter rate decline. Hypertensive injury narrows arterioles and causes ischaemia. Chronic inflammation produces crescents that heal into scars. Interstitial disease scars support tissue and capillaries. Proteinuria itself damages tubules and accelerates decline.

steps.tx: Early CKD is asymptomatic, with hypertension, anaemia and metabolic abnormalities appearing late. **Normocytic anaemia** (normal sized red cells) from erythropoietin deficiency (kidney hormone lack) is universal. **Mineral bone disorder** (calcium phosphate imbalance) causes itching and fractures. **Metabolic acidosis** (acid buildup) causes muscle wasting. **Uraemic syndrome** (toxin symptoms) with pericarditis, encephalopathy and bleeding marks end stage disease.
steps.say: Early disease is asymptomatic, with hypertension and anaemia and metabolic problems appearing late. Anaemia from kidney hormone deficiency is universal. Bone mineral imbalance causes itching and fractures. Acid buildup causes muscle wasting. Toxins cause heart sac inflammation and brain dysfunction and bleeding in end stage disease.

steps.tx: **Estimated glomerular filtration rate** (CKD EPI creatinine) is the core test, repeated to confirm chronicity. **Urine albumin to creatinine ratio** (protein quantification) is the most sensitive early marker. **Renal ultrasound** (kidney scan) shows small contracted kidneys in chronic disease and normal size in acute disease. **Kidney biopsy** (tissue sample) is gold standard for glomerular diagnosis when active disease is suspected.
steps.say: Calculated filter rate is the core test, repeated to confirm chronicity. Urine albumin ratio is the most sensitive early marker. Ultrasound shows small contracted kidneys in chronic disease and normal size in acute disease. Biopsy is the gold standard for glomerular diagnosis.

steps.tx: **Angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors** (ACE inhibitors, proteinuria reducers) and angiotensin receptor blockers are first line for albuminuria. **Sodium glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors** (dapagliflozin, kidney protection) slow progression in diabetes and proteinuria. **Nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid antagonists** (finerenone) add benefit in diabetic disease. **Blood pressure target** below 130 over 80 mmHg is standard for albuminuric disease. **Statins** (cholesterol reducers) reduce cardiovascular death.
steps.say: ACE inhibitors and ARBs are first line for albuminuria. SGLT2 inhibitors like dapagliflozin slow progression in diabetes and proteinuria. Finerenone adds benefit in diabetic disease. Blood pressure below one thirty over eighty is standard for albuminuric disease. Statins reduce cardiovascular death.

steps.tx: **Kidney replacement therapy** (dialysis or transplant) starts below eGFR 15 or with uraemic symptoms. **Conservative kidney care** (symptom control without dialysis) suits elderly and multimorbid patients. **Vaccination** (hepatitis B, influenza, pneumococcal) is recommended in CKD. **Anemia correction** (iron and erythropoietin) improves quality of life. **Dietary protein moderation** (0.8 g per kg) and sodium restriction support progression control.
steps.say: Replacement therapy starts below fifteen or with uraemic symptoms. Conservative symptom care suits elderly and multimorbid patients. Vaccination against hepatitis B and influenza is recommended. Iron and erythropoietin improve anaemia. Moderate protein and sodium restriction support progression control.

steps.tx: **Hyperkalaemia** (high potassium) needs dietary restriction and binders before dialysis. **Metabolic bone disease** (CKD mineral disorder) needs phosphate binders, vitamin D and parathyroid control. **Acidosis** (acid buildup) needs bicarbonate when below 22 mmol per litre. **Uraemic bleeding** (platelet dysfunction) needs desmopressin and dialysis. **Cardiovascular disease** (heart attack and failure) kills most CKD patients before kidney failure.
steps.say: High potassium needs diet restriction and binders before dialysis. Bone mineral disorder needs phosphate binders and vitamin D and parathyroid control. Acid buildup needs bicarbonate below twenty two. Uraemic bleeding needs desmopressin and dialysis. Heart disease kills most CKD patients before kidney failure.

steps.tx: Early CKD mortality is driven by cardiovascular disease, while late CKD mortality adds infection and uraemia. **Kidney failure** (eGFR below 15) needs planned replacement or conservative care. **Albuminuria progression** (rising protein) predicts kidney failure better than eGFR slope alone. Timely nephrology referral above eGFR 60 with albuminuria improves outcomes. Late referral is a common Indian pitfall.
steps.say: Early mortality is driven by heart disease, while late disease adds infection and uraemia. Kidney failure needs planned replacement or conservative care. Rising protein predicts failure better than filter rate slope alone. Timely nephrology referral improves outcomes. Late referral is a common Indian pitfall.

steps.tx: Kidney Disease Improving Global Outcomes 2024 updated albuminuria categories, SGLT2 use and finerenone thresholds. **International Society of Nephrology** Indian data stress diabetic and hypertensive dominance. Examination traps include diagnosing CKD from one low eGFR without three month chronicity, missing albuminuria in diabetic screening, and starting NSAIDs in advanced disease. Elderly muscle loss overestimates eGFR and needs cystatin confirmation.
steps.say: Current guidance updates albuminuria categories and SGLT2 use and finerenone thresholds. Indian data stress diabetic and hypertensive dominance. Traps include diagnosing from one low reading without chronicity, missing albuminuria in diabetic screening, and starting painkillers in advanced disease. Elderly muscle loss overestimates filter rate and needs cystatin confirmation.

steps.tx: The **high yield table** gathers eGFR cutoffs, albuminuria grades and drug pillars. Kidneys failure thresholds, albumin categories and SGLT2 indications are the most asked points in theory and ward viva examinations. CKDu heat exposure and diabetic dominance are favourite Indian viva themes that need precise recall.
